parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet, used to open and close the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the interior shelves and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: The middle shelf is a horizontal divider inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is the topmost internal divider of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lighter items and helps organize the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body and structure of the storage cabinet, made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the door and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
